name: Kota (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kota town emblem in white: a stylised letter D-shaped device enclosing a ring.
history: Municipal flag of Kota, a town in Aichi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The flag was adopted on 1 May 2012; the emblem dates from 1 September 1959.

features.role: Kota town emblem — a stylised letter D-shaped device enclosing a ring
